# Opeyemi Adegboye (Yemi) — Product Designer, Product Engineer, UI/UX Designer & Tutor

> Portfolio and Professional Profile of Opeyemi Adegboye (also known as Yemi / yemiSage). Digital Product Designer, Product Engineer, UI/UX Designer, UI Developer, and Design Educator specializing in high-utility web & mobile platforms, scalable design systems, and rapid prototyping.

## Summary & Target Categories
- **Primary Roles**: Product Designer, UI/UX Designer, Product Engineer, UI Developer, Design Engineer, Mid-Level Product Designer, Junior to Mid-Level UI/UX Designer, UI/UX Tutor & Design Mentor.
- **Core Disciplines**: Digital Product Design, User Experience (UX) Design, User Interface (UI) Design, Product Engineering, Design Systems, Rapid Prototyping, Design Thinking, User Research, Wireframing, Usability Testing, Interaction Design, Frontend UI Development.
- **Key Tools**: Figma, Framer, React, HTML5/CSS3, Miro, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, VS Code, Google AI Studio, Claude, Notion, Trello.
- **Domains & Industry Experience**: B2B & B2C SaaS, FinTech (cross-border payments, stablecoins), EdTech & Exam Prep platforms, Real Estate & Community Living Security Systems, Sports & Scouting Analytics, Travel & Service Marketplaces, Logistics & Fleet Tracking.
- **Background**: Degree background in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, bringing strong analytical systems thinking, engineering logic, and pixel-precise visual craft to product design and frontend collaboration.

## Core Capabilities
- **Product Design & UX Strategy**: End-to-end user journeys, user research, wireframing, high-fidelity UI design, user testing, conversion optimization, and design thinking workshops.
- **Design Systems Architecture**: Reusable component libraries, design token hierarchies, scalable Figma libraries, documentation, and seamless designer-to-developer handoff.
- **Prototyping & Product Engineering**: Interactive Figma prototypes, Framer websites, functional React components, code-level UI development, micro-interactions, and animations.
- **UI/UX Tutoring & Mentorship**: Teaching design principles, Figma masterclasses, Design Thinking methodologies, portfolio building, and career guidance for junior and aspiring designers.

## Selected Portfolio Projects & Case Studies
- [TASAfrica](/projects/tasafrica): Discovery platform & design system connecting African sporting talent with international scouts. Features talent profiling, scouting workflows, and video analytics.
- [Limestone App](/projects/limestone): Estate security and residential community access management platform. Designed offline visitor check-ins, instant panic triggers, and estate administrator portals.
- **Xeruit Talent**: AI-powered hiring operating system designed for verified tech talent discovery and candidate assessment.
- **Norocio**: Cross-border fintech platform supporting multi-currency accounts, stablecoin payments, and global remittances.
- **Stayafrika**: Travel accommodation marketplace for discovering authentic stays, local experiences, and services across Africa.
- **Soludesks**: B2B SaaS platform for corporate team training, employee attendance, and enterprise operations.
- **AfternoonPrep**: UK-based online learning and exam preparation platform for structured student revision.
- **Flxfleet**: Canadian fleet logistics, delivery dispatch, driver booking, and real-time shipment tracking.
- **Feexeet**: On-demand home and facility services marketplace connecting vetted tradespeople with property owners.
